notes.title: Chrono Sword ver. 1.1.08 update – Sept. 25th, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow time travelers.[/p][p]Thank you all for supporting Chrono Sword during the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on all of your feedback, we've made improvements in all sorts of areas. We hope that all of these new additions and improvements provide a satisfying, enjoyable gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Let us fill you in on the important changes coming in this update.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Gameplay system changes[/p][p]- Level-up system simplified: Stats are now automatically increased on level up, and an additional 'Cyl Cryst' has been added as a reward.[/p][p]- Skill tree system: Players may now use the Cyl Cryst they obtain to learn the skills they wish to use, improve stats, or unlock certain actions.[/p][p]- Separating swords and shields: You can now freely swap out and combine various sword and shield combinations.[/p][p]- Index NPCs: Increased accessibility by making various NPCs, like merchants, appear next to Indexes.[/p][p]- Several other of the finer gameplay systems have been improved.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Improved combat and movement[/p][p]- Improved running: Players can now make the character run by pushing the stick harder.[/p][p]- Targeting system improved: The 'targeting vs. not targeting' method has now been changed to 'auto vs. manual targeting.'[/p][p]- Parrying improvements: Now, after unlocking the appropriate skill, a successful Just Guard will trigger a parry.[/p][p]- Just Avoid bonus: After unlocking the appropriate skill, a successful Just Avoid now recharges the 'Glyph of Healing.'[/p][p]- Several other combat and movement systems have been improved for your experience.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Improved learning curve, difficulty, level design[/p][p]- Added difficulty selections: You can now choose your difficulty on selecting a new game.[/p][p]- Improved tutorials: The game now shows tutorial tips, and the levels are designed to allow players to adapt to the overall gameplay experience more easily.[/p][p]- Level design improvements: Level configuration, enemy placement, and background design have all been improved to help players understand the overall flow of the game.[/p][p]- Penalty for deaths adjusted: Only 50% of Cyl will be dropped on death, allowing for players to get back on track more easily.[/p][p]Other learning curve, difficulty, and level design improvements have been made alongside this.[/p][p][/p][p]■ UI/UX Improvements[/p][p]- In-game menu improved: Each menu has been improved to open immediately or quickly switch to another menu.[/p][p]- Integrated inventory: Equipment, inventory, and stats have been combined to be seen on a single screen to help with visibility.[/p][p]- Map system improved: The locations you've explored in the past and future are displayed in each zone for each timeline, increasing the fun of exploration.[/p][p]- Improved language and resolution display: Fixed problems such as fonts displaying incorrectly for certain words, UI distorting at certain resolutions, and more.[/p][p]Several other UI/UX improvements have been made.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Improved overall quality and production value[/p][p]- Strengthened early-game experience: Improved early-game level design and production value to make a more immersive, exciting experience.[/p][p]- Improved terrain height display: Improved background height delineation to make it easier to read and to improve immersion.[/p][p]Improved object visibility: Changed folded ladder design, object placement, and more to help the overall level of understanding.[/p][p]- Improved musical production value: Improved musical production value and added music to events, such as resting at Indexes, boss phase transitions, and more.[/p][p]- Several other game quality/optimization issues have been improved upon.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Bug fixes[/p][p]- Fixed issues where the game would not continue progressing as usual.[/p][p]- Fixed issues where interactions in the past and future, such as door/object interactions, were not working as intended.[/p][p]- Fixed issues where the targeting system would unlock from a target.[/p][p]- Fixed combat-related bugs, such as when no knockback was applied when shot or the player couldn't pass through lasting spewed enemy projections.[/p][p][/p][p]Numerous other bugs have also been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue striving to make a better gameplay experience into the future.[/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Chrono Sword Update Notice - September 15th, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow time travelers,[/p][p][/p][p]This is David from the Chrono Sword dev team, 21cDucks.[/p][p][/p][p]Chrono Sword will be getting its first update since entering early access. This first update will drop on Thursday, September 25th.[/p][p][/p][p]As I let you all know before, we've been thinking from multiple angles about how to improve the fun and overall experience of the game, and this update is sure to improve many parts of the gameplay experience and quality-of-life features that you've been suggesting.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll inform you all of the contents to be included in this update very soon![/p][p][/p][p]As you play through Chrono Sword moving forward, feel free to share your thoughts on how to improve our game through the various channels available. Thank you, one and all![/p][p][/p][p]Best wishes to everyone,[/p][p]David[/p]

notes.title: Announcing the 2025 Steam Early Access update roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello from the team at CFK.

We are excited to introduce today the 2025 Steam Early Access update roadmap for new pixel art souls-like action RPG 'Chrono Sword'.

'Chrono Sword' has continued to garner a great amount of interest through various online and offline events ahead of its December 6th release to Steam Early Access. With how long players have been anticipating this release, this launch to Early Access has drawn even more interest and favorable responses from players around the globe.

In response to all this interest, CFK and 21cDucks are sharing the 2025 update roadmap for players to check the planned development for the Steam Early Access period. With this, players will be able to see what new content and features will be added moving forward.

In addition to the contents and features to be added, both companies plan to actively respond to and factor in feedback given during the Early Access period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/4a51a84405d3ef6e67013aeecc21889c766f1272.jpg[/img]

The overall direction set for the Early Access Chrono Sword roadmap is: ▲ quickly stabilizing the Early Access build and ▲ filling out content completion and increasing overall user satisfaction. Specific details about each step in the roadmap will be announced at a later date.

To begin, in the first quarter of the year, we will be focusing on content quality improvements and responding to player feedback. Alongside this, we will be polishing the level-up system, skill tree system, and adding in new accessories and items. The first half of Chapter 4 will also be added in as a new area.

During the second quarter, main story events and NPC interaction events will be added, the male/female playable characters will be made available, chapter 4 will be expanded upon with its second half, and players will be able to experience chapter 5 as well. In the third quarter, extra bosses, weapons, and armor will be added alongside chapters 6 and 7 as new areas.

In the last (fourth) quarter of the year, the team will focus on content quality improvements, responding to player feedback, and adding in chapter 8 as a new area. After the Early Access period, CFK and 21cDucks will officially launch the game after filling it out with a number of additional regions and other content.

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

notes.title: Chrono Sword to release their latest demo during Steam Next Fest 2024!
notes.notes:
Hello from the team at CFK.

Chrono Sword, the pixel art soulslike action RPG, is [b]officially participating in Steam Next Fest 2024 October edition.[/b] Play the official demo for the game starting [b]October 11th![/b]

The demo appearing at Steam Next Fest 2024 goes way beyond the version released during the crowdfunding campaign, emphasizing the action and RPG elements of the soulslike genre that have been developed during the years of research-led improvements made on the game. It was featured at this year's Tokyo Game Show 2024, garnering interest and positive reactions from fans.

In addition, we've released portrait illustrations of the two playable characters that will carry you through the past and future on their journey! Players can choose a male or female character to play through the game with according to their preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/b037b673624376b32c348cbd982261f38bb03f91.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/ecdc6b78c5ba2e5b0936abb82818d3c06cc982fb.jpg[/img]

We hope you'll play through this charming demo for yourself during the Steam Next Fest 2024, and we also hope you'll share your own thoughts about the game as it continues to update and improve before its official release!

As always, thank you for your continued support as we at CFK strive to be the very best publisher we can be.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update of August
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/0b4d8a97ba61a6cd7bc926ed0fdc9eba232c71ec.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Time Travelers![/h3]

This is David, the head of 21st century Ducks.

It's already August, time's flying so fast.

I was busy with BitSummit, and there was many changes in the game and in the team.


[h1]BitSummit[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/dd9e7d9d6ca0de2bb92b587d73b6afefa3e9f803.jpg[/img]

This was the 2nd exhibition with Chrono Sword at BitSummit. I thought that it could be a great chance to confirm if players notice and like our hard work on improving the play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/531035b9ba767d913d538e5cde9f2f024e7d2dc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/547b9a989afaff8c5a1d470c52e984d63feadefe.jpg[/img]

It is not a smart to give players a 1~3hours demo in a game show since most boothes prepare 5~10 min session. But I let players can play the demo as much as they want, in that way, I could catch how players feel through the whole demo. Everyday I fixed the demo with team again and again so that players could enjoy the game smoother next day.

I wish I could post the review of the show soon.


[h1]The Team[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/b3ff477af8b0ef5a3f4b13ebf7f3dfd235a0e3e9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/18b5f9fa03d644d72ea16b5191bb11cdc93d73a1.jpg[/img]

I discussed with the team about our productivity and the release window several times, and decided to make the team a bit larger. I'm already working with a new concept artist to improve the visual of the game. And though it will take time, there will be more hiring to help building the environments and so on.


[h1]The Game[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/d94289c96196aa2dd4931999d02b628b6660b22e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/41deb84b5f5c86c9d0a38385058183fdcdfef8b9.png[/img]

Chrono Sword is clearly very fun game. I can say it, not only to soulslike fans but also to more light players. 

But through the open on Steam and two exhibitions at PAX and BitSummit, I found a critical weakness of Chrono Sword. I focused on creating a unique experience of authentic action and time-travel in Chrono Sword meantime, but you can never feel it through screenshots, since it is rely on the move of characters and changing of the environment. 

I wanted Chrono Sword to stand out more than other games even just from screenshots. So after many discussion and trying, I built a new settings. The visual moved closer to intensity, darkness and uniqueness away from typical fantasy. Of course this change causes more works, but I think it won't make a delay.

I hope I can share the updated visual soon.


[h1]The Test[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/614a1daf475d85a06b2052c2549abb949daa60f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680561/fb8f615ceccacaef9020ba2a95544f4bbf82fbd4.png[/img]

I'm discussing with the team about Early Access in this year. Current plan is to start with 40% of contents, about 10 hours of playtime and to update remaining contents further.


Before it, [b]I'm preparing a closed test[/b] to listen your opinion. It is with 1~3 hours demo for who have applied for participation only. [b]I'll open a application form soon.[/b]


I know that there could be questions since I don't share the exact release date, but it is to not give you unnecessary confusion. I hope you understand that my team is working with passion everyday, to give you the best game.


Thank you for reading.

I'll see you with an invitation for closed test soon!
